"""Temporary selected tridiagonal GPU experiment; not a production backend."""
import json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np,torch,warp as wp
from physics_engine.quantum import schrodinger_1d as cpu
wp.set_module_options({'enable_backward':False,'fast_math':False,'fuse_fp':False})
@wp.kernel
def selected(d:wp.array(dtype=wp.float64),off:wp.float64,lo:wp.float64,hi:wp.float64,ev:wp.array(dtype=wp.float64)):
    j=wp.tid();n=d.shape[0];a=lo;b=hi
    for it in range(64):
        x=(a+b)*wp.float64(.5);q=d[0]-x;count=int(0)
        if wp.abs(q)<wp.float64(1.e-100):q=wp.float64(-1.e-100)
        if q<wp.float64(0.):count+=1
        for i in range(1,n):
            q=d[i]-x-off*off/q
            if wp.abs(q)<wp.float64(1.e-100):q=wp.float64(-1.e-100)
            if q<wp.float64(0.):count+=1
        if count<=j:a=x
        else:b=x
    ev[j]=(a+b)*wp.float64(.5)
@wp.kernel
def vectors(d:wp.array(dtype=wp.float64),off:wp.float64,ev:wp.array(dtype=wp.float64),p:wp.array2d(dtype=wp.float64),v:wp.array2d(dtype=wp.float64)):
    j=wp.tid();n=d.shape[0];shift=ev[j]+wp.float64(1.e-7)*wp.max(wp.float64(1.),wp.abs(ev[j]))
    p[j,0]=d[0]-shift
    v[j,0]=wp.float64(1.)
    for i in range(1,n):
        q=d[i]-shift-off*off/p[j,i-1]
        if wp.abs(q)<wp.float64(1.e-100):q=wp.float64(1.e-100)
        p[j,i]=q;v[j,i]=wp.sin(wp.float64(i+1)*wp.float64(1.23456789))
    for it in range(4):
        for i in range(1,n):v[j,i]=v[j,i]-off*v[j,i-1]/p[j,i-1]
        v[j,n-1]=v[j,n-1]/p[j,n-1]
        for back in range(n-1):
            i=n-2-back;v[j,i]=(v[j,i]-off*v[j,i+1])/p[j,i]
        norm=wp.float64(0.)
        for i in range(n):norm+=v[j,i]*v[j,i]
        norm=wp.sqrt(norm)
        for i in range(n):v[j,i]=v[j,i]/norm

def solve(V,dx,k):
    diagonal=1./dx**2+V;off=-.5/dx**2;n=len(V)
    d=wp.array(diagonal,dtype=wp.float64,device='cuda');e=wp.empty(k,dtype=wp.float64,device='cuda');p=wp.empty((k,n),dtype=wp.float64,device='cuda');v=wp.empty_like(p)
    wp.launch(selected,k,inputs=[d,off,float(diagonal.min()-2*abs(off)),float(diagonal.max()+2*abs(off)),e],device='cuda')
    wp.launch(vectors,k,inputs=[d,off,e,p,v],device='cuda')
    return e.numpy(),v.numpy().T/np.sqrt(dx)
wp.init();torch.set_num_threads(1);solve(np.zeros(16),.1,3)
rows=[]
for case in ('oscillator','well','asymmetric'):
 n=2000;x=np.linspace(-6,6,n);dx=x[1]-x[0];V=.5*x*x;k=6
 if case=='well':V=np.zeros(n);dx=1./(n-1);k=5
 if case=='asymmetric':V+=.12*np.sin(1.7*x)
 E,P=cpu.solve(V,dx,k)
 for repeat in range(2):
  t=time.perf_counter();G,Q=solve(V,dx,k);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t
  Q*=np.where(np.sum(P*Q,axis=0)<0,-1.,1.)
  residual=(1/dx**2+V)[:,None]*Q-G*Q;residual[1:]+=-.5/dx**2*Q[:-1];residual[:-1]+=-.5/dx**2*Q[1:]
  rows.append(dict(case=case,repeat=repeat,seconds=elapsed,energy_error=float(np.max(np.abs(G-E))),vector_error=float(np.max(np.abs(Q-P))),vector_normalized=float(np.max(np.abs(Q-P)/(1.e-8+1.e-6*np.abs(P)))),residual=float(np.max(np.abs(residual))),orthogonality=float(np.max(np.abs(Q.T@Q*dx-np.eye(k)))),energies=G.tolist()))
out=Path('reports/schrodinger_selected_experiment_v1');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),rows=rows,source=Path(__file__).read_text()),indent=2)+'\n');print(rows)
